mentions.name: minigames.world
mentions.description: A low-budget games website built as a Laravel app that is solely interactable through a TUI application, so Claude Code can help operate it. Collected data is analyzed with Jupyter notebooks to support decision-making. In development since early October 2025.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a games website called https://minigames.world
It’s really low budget, but the idea might be interesting to you.
It’s a Laravel app that’s solely interactable through a TUI application, so Claude Code can help me operate it.
To support my decision-making, I analyze collected data with Jupyter notebooks.
